figures.caption: Table 6: Evaluation under mixed velocity commands. We compare the learned unified model with the heuristic-best baseline across commanded forward velocities while additionally sampling lateralvelocity and yaw-rate commands from (v⋆y ∈ [−0.4, 0.4],m, s−1) and (ω⋆z ∈ [−0.4, 0.4], rad, s−1), respectively. This setting evaluates robustness beyond straight-line forward locomotion. Lower CoT is better; higher survival and success rates are better.

Table 3: Benchmark comparison across commanded forward velocities. Each entry reports mean ± standard deviation over 20 rollouts. Lower CoT is better; higher survival and success are better. Success means the average post-warmup forward speed stays within ±15% of the commanded speed.
